22:   // Tunnel obstacles (bars) and collectable orbs
23:   const bars = []; // each {y, gapX, gapW, height}
24:   const orbs = []; // each {x, y, r, collected}
25:   let frame = 0;
26:   let score = 0;
27:   let gameOver = false;
28: 
29:   // Input handling – left/right arrows or A/D keys
30:   const keys = {};
31:   // Audio context for sound effects
32:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
33:   // Ensure audio context is resumed on first user interaction
34:   const resumeAudio = () => { if (audioCtx.state === 'suspended') audioCtx.resume(); };
35:   window.addEventListener('keydown', e => {

43:   });
44:   // Simple tone generator
45:   function playTone(freq, dur) {
46:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
47:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
48:     osc.type = 'sine';
49:     osc.frequency.value = freq;
50:     osc.connect(gain);
51:     gain.connect(audioCtx.destination);
52:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.0001, audioCtx.currentTime);
53:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.01);
54:     osc.start();
55:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.0001, audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
56:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + dur);
57:   }
58:   function playCollect() { playTone(800, 0.15); }
59:   function playCrash() { playTone(150, 0.4); }
60:   function playScore() { playTone(600, 0.1); }
61: 
62:   function spawnBar() {

64:     const gapX = Math.random() * (width - gapW);

76:   function update() {

91:     if (ball.x + ball.r > width) ball.x = width - ball.r;
92: 
93:     // Scroll tunnel upwards
